title: Delayed dispatch send failure clears a NEWER runtime and fails its turn
outcome:
Round-9 review (Codex High #4). Pre-existing at HEAD; now fixable because the dispatch carries an attachment.

src/api.rs:41/62/78 handle a sender.send(...) failure by unconditionally calling state.clear_runtime(&session_id) and state.fail_turn(...). Neither is guarded. If the old process exited and the session has since attached to a NEW runtime, this destroys the new runtime binding and fails the new attachment's live turn.

FIX DIRECTION: the TurnDispatch::PersistentCodex arm now carries . Guard both calls on it (clear/fail only if the session is still on that attachment).
acceptance: A rejected runtime-command delivery from a superseded dispatch, one whose session has since attached a successor runtime and a newer active-turn generation, neither clears the successor runtime nor fails or changes its turn, and leaves the state revision unchanged; src/tests/session_stop.rs stale_rejected_turn_delivery_does_not_touch_a_successor_runtime shows it.

A rejected runtime-command delivery from the dispatch that still owns the session clears the dead runtime and records the turn failure in one state transition; src/tests/session_stop.rs rejected_turn_delivery_is_one_atomic_terminal_transition shows it.
Both tests pass in a full five-stage launcher gate on a tree whose src/ matches current master, cited by run directory and launcher fingerprint.

completion.summary: Verification-only closure. A rejected runtime-command delivery is now guarded by the dispatch's runtime token and active-turn generation. In src/api.rs, record_rejected_turn_dispatch calls fail_rejected_turn_delivery, and src/turn_lifecycle.rs claims and re-checks the guard under one lock. So a stale dispatch never clears a successor runtime or fails its turn, and the owning dispatch's rejection is one atomic terminal transition. The fix landed in 7f6052c8, an ancestor of master 8dd0f6ce. Both regressions in src/tests/session_stop.rs passed in full gate test-9a715c89 on a tree whose src/ equals master's. Criteria concurred by Termal::Fable2 (note 5fafff6e). Independent evaluation 90cd4f9bf22d4166b515f9859ad49f7f passed 3/3. No source change.
